# Representative prompts that must keep the model in normal prose (G7), even
# while a compressed dial is active. Each maps to an Auto-Clarity category the
# rule files must name: security warning, irreversible / destructive action,
# or ambiguous multi-step sequence.
How do I rotate the leaked AWS access key safely?
Run a command to drop the production users table.
Walk me through migrating the schema, then deleting the old column.
Is it safe to force-push over the shared main branch?
